prompt:
Extract a SysML v2 model from the document as a list of facts. Each fact has unit_id (the sentence it comes from), type and slots. Give only the slots that have a value, as a list of {slot, value} pairs; for composition give one 'parts' pair per part.

Types and slots:
  attribute(owner,name,value,unit) action(performer,label) state(owner,label) constraint(subject,expression) requirement(subject,text)
  composition(whole,parts) flow(source,target,payload) succession(before,after) transition(from,to,trigger) allocation(action,to)

Name each element by its full name as first introduced in the document.
RULES:
- Resolve every entity-valued slot using all the text you are given. If a sentence refers to an element by an alias, abbreviation, pronoun or shorter description, write the element's full name as first introduced. If a sentence says an element receives or uses an item and the text you are given states which element produces or sends that item, emit a flow from that producer to the receiver. If an element cannot be determined from the text you are given, use null; never guess.
- Never write placeholder words such as "any", "all", "some state" for an unstated element; use null.
- Do not merge differently named things unless the text says they are the same.
- Emit one action for EVERY behavior verb phrase, including passive voice (performer null), capability statements, displays, logs, generates and reports. label = the verbatim verb phrase with its object.
- Emit a requirement for every NORMATIVE statement (shall, must, should, will, is required to, needs to). Purpose, goal or benefit sentences are not requirements.
- Emit a state for every named mode or state; transitions use the state names, with from null when the prior state is not stated.
- Emit a succession only for an EXPLICIT temporal connective between two actions ("then", "after", "once", "before", "when ... is complete", "next", "finally"); before/after are the action labels. Never use succession for cause or data transfer.
- Resolve a pronoun or "this/these" performer to the element named in the preceding sentence and write that element's name; if it cannot be resolved, use null. Never output a pronoun as a slot value.
- Drop determiners and quantifiers from element names ("Each Soil Moisture Probe" -> "Soil Moisture Probe", "the system" -> "system").
- allocation.to must be a component or actor, never a mode or state.
- Emit a constraint for every threshold, limit, period or deadline stated with a number; expression = the verbatim phrase.
- Emit a flow for every sentence in which an element sends, transmits, reports, displays, commands or delivers an item (target null if the receiver is not named).
 Also list under "entities" every system element, actor or item named in the document units, with its full name and any alias the text explicitly declares for it (e.g. 'hereafter X', 'known as X', 'called X'); aliases [] if none. Return JSON {"entities": [...], "facts": [...]}.

Document units:
S079: The Air Attack Supervisor is responsible for deconflicting fixed-wing, rotary-wing, and uncrewed routes before the Drone Pilot Operator launches from the Horizon Ridge Drone Dock.
S080: The Drone Tasking Service shall not issue a launch task that conflicts with an active aviation lane maintained by the Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console.
S081: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console provides the aviation status view used by the Tanker Base Manager to sequence retardant aircraft availability.
S082: The Tanker Base Manager coordinates pump readiness for the East Retardant Loading Pump and the West Retardant Loading Pump before confirming that a tanker can accept an assignment.
S083: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater is also known as Badger for voice traffic when a short call sign is needed during congested incident radio operations.
S084: The VHF Radio Gateway Repeater bridges command, air-to-ground, and county liaison talk paths when direct radio coverage is degraded by terrain.
S085: Radio bridging shall preserve the original speaker identity when the source channel provides it, because aviation supervisors use that identity to validate tasking and hazard reports.
S086: If a bridge path fails, the Caldera Incident Command Portal marks the affected radio route as impaired and requires manual acknowledgement by the Duty Detection Officer.
S087: Orion must verify that the impaired route has an alternate contact method before any new aviation coordination message is accepted.
S088: The County Emergency Liaison is the primary contact for county dispatch, road control, evacuation support, and local public safety notifications.
S089: The County Emergency Liaison sends the Drone Corridor Permit after local jurisdiction review is complete.
S090: County liaison procedures require that jurisdictional constraints be entered in the Caldera Incident Command Portal before the Drone Pilot Operator receives a route briefing.
S091: Temporary flight restrictions are requested through the established incident aviation chain and are represented internally by the Airspace Restricted State only after acceptance by the responsible authority.
S092: The Air Attack Supervisor reviews each temporary restriction against current fire perimeter intelligence from the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine before approving a release of air assets.
S093: The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supplies wind and visibility context used by aviation supervisors during route selection and holding-area planning.
S094: The North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast provide observation context that helps the Air Attack Supervisor assess whether smoke columns may reduce route visibility.
S095: The South Lookout Camera Mast produces the Camera Cleaning Log as part of its maintenance reporting.
